# Popular Science

> Popular Science delivers cutting-edge science news, technology stories, gear reviews, and DIY projects for curious minds since 1872.

As a leading science and technology publication, Popular Science covers breakthrough discoveries across health, environment, and innovation while providing expert product reviews and consumer guides. The site engages over 280,000 newsletter subscribers with daily science stories and curated tech trends.

## Key Topics

- Science News
- Technology Innovation
- Gear Reviews
- Product Reviews
- NASA
- Neanderthals
- Marine Biology
- Psychology
- Environmental Science
- Best of What's New Awards
- DIY Projects
- Consumer Products
- Sustainability
- Health & Medicine
- Tech Trends

## Core Content & Homepage

- [Popular Science | Science and Technology Stories Since 1872](https://www.popsci.com): Popular Science homepage: science news, tech stories, DIY projects, gear reviews
- [Learn something new every day with the Popular Science newsletters](https://www.popsci.com/email-signup): Newsletter signup page for 280,000+ science and tech enthusiasts

## Innovation & Awards

- [The 50 greatest innovations of 2025](https://www.popsci.com/gear/best-of-whats-new-2025): 38th annual Best of What's New awards showcasing innovation and tech trends

## Science & Discovery

- [Neanderthals used antibiotics, new experiment suggests](https://www.popsci.com/health/neanderthals-antibiotic-birch-tar-medicine): Neanderthal antibiotic use through birch tar wound treatment discovery
- [Not everyone has an internal monologue](https://www.popsci.com/health/does-everyone-have-internal-monologue): Internal monologue psychology study by Dr. Russell Hurlburt
- [How marine mammals stay hydrated in a salty sea](https://www.popsci.com/environment/how-do-sea-mammals-stay-hydrated): Marine mammal hydration mechanisms from University of Miami researcher
- [Cockapoos, doodles, and other crossbreeds have behavioral problems, too](https://www.popsci.com/environment/crossbreed-dog-behavioral-problems): Crossbreed dog behavioral problems study from Royal Veterinary College
- [NASA wants your hail photos](https://www.popsci.com/environment/nasa-hail-photos): NASA citizen science project seeking hail photos for storm forecasting
- [7 glittery minerals up for auction](https://www.popsci.com/science/loomis-fine-minerals-auction): Heritage Auctions Loomis Fine Minerals collection featuring 200+ specimens
- [Volunteers spend 30 years restoring a Victorian sewer pump station](https://www.popsci.com/technology/victorian-sewer-pump-restoration-england): Claymills Pumping Station restoration project in Staffordshire, England
